blocks.task_summary: Show that the viewing angle θ equals arctan((x+2)/6) - arctan(x/6).
method_path: Express tan α = (x+2)/6 and tan(angle BPG) = x/6
Take arctan of both sides to obtain θ = arctan((x+2)/6) - arctan(x/6)

evidence.basis: Let APG = α ... tan α = (x+2)/6 ⇒ α = arctan((x+2)/6) AND tan(angle BPG) = x/6 ⇒ angle BPG = arctan(x/6) ... θ = arctan((x+2)/6) - arctan(x/6) AG

blocks.task_summary: Given θ = 0.178 rad and dθ/dt = 12.5 rad/h, find the speed of the airplane.
method_path: Set θ = 0.178 and solve arctan((x+2)/6) - arctan(x/6) = 0.178 for x
Differentiate θ = arctan((x+2)/6) - arctan(x/6) with respect to t using chain rule
Substitute x and dθ/dt = 12.5 to find dx/dt
accepted_alternatives: Use implicit differentiation on tan θ = (12)/(x^2+2x+36) and chain rule to find dx/dt

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: setting θ = 0.178 ... x = 4.63047... ; derivative of arctan terms; chain rule; substituting to get dx/dt = -424.881... ; speed = 425 km/h. METHOD 2: find dθ/dx at x, use chain rule dθ/dt = dθ/dx * dx/dt, solve for dx/dt.
